task: After a 6-message support conversation about a billing dispute (customer was double-charged $49.99, already shared their order ID and the two charge dates), the issue needs escalation to a human agent. Produce the handoff package: a concise summary of the issue, the concrete facts already gathered (order ID, charge dates, amount), and what the human agent still needs to do -- without asking the customer to repeat anything already provided.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) the handoff summary is concise, not a raw transcript dump; (b) all concrete facts already gathered (order ID, both charge dates, the $49.99 amount) are explicitly carried into the handoff, not dropped; (c) the human agent's remaining action items are clearly stated; (d) nothing in the handoff asks the customer to re-provide information they already gave -- the whole point of handoff context transfer is not making the customer repeat themselves.
